themes_detail.label: Street Infrastructure Damage Spike
themes_detail.summary: Street signs are being damaged at 3x normal rates this week (9 complaints THIS WEEK vs. 3.1 weekly average), suggesting either weather damage, vehicle collisions, or vandalism requiring urgent investigation in Far Rockaway.
evidence: Street Sign - Damaged complaints: 9 THIS WEEK vs. 3.1 weekly average (188% spike, z-score: 3.64)
Statistically significant deviation from 8-week baseline established this week
Coincides with recent winter weather and heavy construction activity (418 DOB permits filed in last 90 days)
reporting_angles: Ground reporting: photograph damaged signs across district, interview DOT about repair timeline
Query DOT on root cause: winter weather damage vs. vehicle incidents vs. deferred maintenance

themes_detail.label: Water Quality Crisis Emerging
themes_detail.summary: Water quality complaints exploded to 4 this week from a baseline of 0.2 per week—a 1500% spike—signaling a potential contamination or infrastructure failure affecting drinking water safety in the Rockaways.
evidence: Water Quality complaints: 4 last week vs. 0.2 weekly average (1500% spike, z-score: 8.66, severity: high)
Highest statistical anomaly in dataset by z-score
Long-standing infrastructure gap: CB budget requests show repeated need for 'capital project for specific street segments currently lacking sanitary sewers'
reporting_angles: Urgent: contact DEP for emergency water quality testing results and public health advisory status
Investigate whether spike correlates with recent dredging or waterfront construction (multiple active ULURPs in district)
Interview residents on water discoloration, odors, or health symptoms; connect to chronic sewer infrastructure gaps flagged in CB budget history

themes_detail.label: Tree Die-Off & Environmental Stress
themes_detail.summary: Dead and dying tree complaints hit 5 last week versus 0.5 weekly average—a 900% spike—potentially indicating storm damage, salt damage, or environmental stress affecting the district's tree canopy.
evidence: Dead/Dying Tree complaints: 5 last week vs. 0.5 weekly average (900% spike, z-score: 9.0, severity: high)
Timing aligns with winter weather and seasonal salt spray in coastal Rockaway neighborhood
CB repeatedly requests 'new or expanded park or amenity' and 'reconstruct or upgrade park'—suggests prior neglect of green infrastructure
reporting_angles: Ask Parks Department: how many trees lost in recent storms; what's the replanting timeline?
Examine whether salt damage from winter road treatment is killing coastal trees disproportionately
Connect to broader environmental resilience concerns in waterfront community facing climate impacts

themes_detail.label: Abandoned Vehicles & Illegal Dumping Wave
themes_detail.summary: Abandoned vehicle complaints spiked 124% two weeks ago (46 complaints vs. 20.5 weekly average), while illegal dumping nearly tripled (16 complaints vs. 6.1 baseline)—signaling organized or environmental quality collapse in the district.
evidence: Abandoned Vehicle complaints 2 weeks ago: 46 vs. 20.5 weekly average (124% spike, z-score: 3.23)
Illegal Dumping complaints 2 weeks ago: 16 vs. 6.1 weekly average (161% spike, z-score: 3.52)
Both spikes converge in same timeframe, suggesting either coordinated dumping activity or environmental enforcement gap
reporting_angles: Canvas neighborhoods for patterns: are abandoned vehicles clustered geographically or randomly distributed?
Interview NYPD and Sanitation on enforcement response; ask for removal timelines
Investigate whether waterfront development activity (Edgemere Commons Phase 2B, multiple rezoning projects) is displacing vehicles or creating dumping opportunities

themes_detail.label: Noise Complaints Sustained Elevation
themes_detail.summary: Noise complaints remain elevated 2 weeks out (32 street/sidewalk noise complaints vs. 12.4 average, +159%) alongside residential noise climbing 79% last week, indicating either ongoing construction or behavioral issues requiring intervention.
evidence: Noise - Street/Sidewalk complaints 2 weeks ago: 32 vs. 12.4 weekly average (159% spike, z-score: 3.83)
Noise - Residential complaints last week: 21 vs. 11.8 weekly average (79% spike, z-score: 4.16)
418 DOB permits filed in past 90 days (236 alterations, 151 new buildings) suggest active construction generating disturbance
reporting_angles: Map noisy construction sites against DOB permits; identify which projects lack adequate noise mitigation plans
Interview residents on sleep disruption and health impacts from sustained noise
Query 311 data for specific locations/times to determine if spike is concentrated or district-wide
